blocks.title: Después de este pdf sabrás
bullets: expresar contraste con but, although, however, despite
expresar causa y consecuencia con because, because of, so, that's why
expresar finalidad con to, in order to, so that
ordenar un texto con firstly, then, finally

head: Palabra
Ejemplo
Posición y forma
rows: but
It was cold, but we went out.
entre dos frases
although / even though
Although it was cold, we went out.
+ frase (sujeto + verbo)
however
It was cold. However, we went out.
al principio de una frase nueva, con coma
despite / in spite of
Despite the cold, we went out.
+ sustantivo o -ing
while / whereas
I like tea, while my wife prefers coffee.
contraste entre dos cosas

blocks.title: despite + sustantivo, although + frase
blocks.text: Despite the rain o Despite being tired, pero Although it was raining. A pesar de que llovía no es despite it was raining, sino although it was raining. Y nunca despite of, aunque en español digas a pesar de.

head: Palabra
Ejemplo
Posición y forma
rows: because
I stayed at home because I was ill.
+ frase
because of
I stayed at home because of the rain.
+ sustantivo
as / since
As it was late, we took a taxi.
+ frase, a menudo al principio
so
It was late, so we took a taxi.
consecuencia, con coma delante
that's why
I was ill. That's why I didn't come.
al principio de una frase nueva
therefore
Prices rose. Therefore, sales fell.
formal, frase nueva

blocks.title: porque = because, por = because of
blocks.text: porque estaba enfermo = because I was ill (con una frase). Pero por la lluvia o a causa de la lluvia = because of the rain (con un sustantivo), nunca because the rain. Y así que o por eso = so o that's why.

head: Palabra
Ejemplo
Español
rows: to
I went to the shop to buy milk.
Fui a la tienda a comprar leche.
in order to
We left early in order to avoid the traffic.
Salimos temprano para evitar los atascos.
so that
I'll write it down so that I don't forget.
Lo apunto para que no se me olvide.
for + naamwoord
We went out for a walk.
Salimos a dar un paseo.

blocks.title: para comprar = to buy, nunca for to buy
blocks.text: para comprar leche = to buy milk. Nunca for to buy, for buy ni for buying cuando hablas de una finalidad. Es uno de los errores más típicos de los hispanohablantes. for solo va con un sustantivo: for a walk, for dinner.

rows: Despite it was raining, we played.
Although it was raining, we played.
Con una frase: although.
Despite of the rain, we played.
Despite the rain, we played.
despite sin of.
I didn't go because the rain.
I didn't go because of the rain.
Con un sustantivo: because of.
I went there for to see her.
I went there to see her.
Finalidad: to.
It was late, however we stayed.
It was late. However, we stayed.
however empieza una frase nueva.
Although it was cold, but we swam.
Although it was cold, we swam.
although y but no van juntos.
Because I was ill I not came.
Because I was ill, I didn't come.
Orden normal, con didn't.

blocks.text: Completa con el conector correcto. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: ______ it was raining, we went for a walk.
items.full: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.

items.q: ______ the rain, we went for a walk.
items.full: Despite the rain, we went for a walk.

items.q: The flight was cancelled ______ the storm.
items.full: The flight was cancelled because of the storm.

items.q: I was hungry, ______ I made a sandwich.
items.full: I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.

items.q: She saved money ______ buy a car.
items.full: She saved money to buy a car.
Speak slowly so that everybody can understand.

items.q: The hotel was nice. ______, the food was terrible.
items.full: The hotel was nice. However, the food was terrible.

items.q: I like summer, ______ my sister prefers winter.
items.full: I like summer, while my sister prefers winter.

items.q: We visited many cities, ______ Rome and Florence.
items.full: We visited many cities, such as Rome and Florence.

items.q: ______ it was late, we took a taxi.
items.full: As it was late, we took a taxi.

items.q: I missed the bus. ______ why I was late.
items.full: I missed the bus. That's why I was late.

items.q: In ______, I think it was a good decision.
items.full: In conclusion, I think it was a good decision.

items.q: Aunque hacía frío, fuimos a nadar.
items.a: Although it was cold, we went swimming.

items.q: Me quedé en casa porque estaba enfermo.
items.a: I stayed at home because I was ill.

items.q: Fui a la tienda a comprar pan.
items.a: I went to the shop to buy bread.

items.q: A pesar de la lluvia, jugamos fuera.
items.a: Despite the rain, we played outside.
